title: Are Mombasa and Dar es Salaam Ports the only first points of entry into the EAC Region? - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# Are Mombasa and Dar es Salaam Ports the only first points of entry into the EAC Region?
No. Airports and other border intra-region loading points are also considered as first points of entry. Border intra-region such as Vurra, Elegu, Oraba, Mpodwe, Busunga, Afogi, Lia, Ishasha River etc.
